title: Reliability of short molecular dynamics runs as screening labels: code and derived data
description: Analysis code and derived data for the paper 'Reliability of Short Molecular Dynamics Runs as Screening Labels: Noise Ceilings, Time Dependence and Adaptive Replicate Allocation'. Uses the public HTP-MD polymer electrolyte simulations (Xie et al., Nat. Commun. 2022). Every number, table and figure of the paper is generated by these scripts.
